comment: Seagallop ferry, BirthIsland_Harbor (pokefirered data/maps/BirthIsland_Harbor/scripts.inc BirthIsland_Harbor_EventScript_Sailor + data/scripts/seagallop.inc). The sailor asks Text_WhereDoYouWantToSail (restored Sevii bank), The greeting line is referenced from its home group (OneIsland) rather than by the bridge ref: the restored bridge entry for this sailor carries the whole sail flow's lines (the greeting plus both departing lines), and the departing line is this script's own next step. the host's menu supplies the destination as exactly one ferry_dest_* transient flag (none = cancelled, the script ends), and the chosen sailing plays the source's departing line -- Text_AllAboardSeagallopNum (bank _common group; {STR_VAR_1} is GetSeagallopNumber's value for the route, supplied by the host as a runner substitution; table in sevii_ferry_wiring.json) -- then fades and warps to the destination harbor's sole warp (id 1). Scripted transfer only (reachability audit B-06): no warp-data edge is added. Its only sailing is the charter return to Vermilion (the source sailor's multichoice is MULTICHOICE_SEAGALLOP_VERMILION). The sailor object already stands on the bound map at (8, 6).
